perks.name: Rapid Hit

notes: Inspired by @Saint_Kabr and @ImpetusAlways (PvE PvE-Minor PvE-GroupAdd PvE-God M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE roll for clearing groups of Minor adds in activities rated Normal difficulty, particularly with Stasis builds. The reprised Redrix's Estoc is a Legacy PR-55 frame pulse rifle which as a subfamily are currently rated D-Tier for endgame PvE by @TheAegisRelic Endgame Analysis spreadsheet in https://www.destiny2.science/ as "essentially just a worse high-impact auto". The frame intrinsic offers built-in anti-Barrier and "dramatically increased accuracy, stability, and targeting while hip firing" as per the https://www.destiny2.science/ Destiny Data Compendium. The stats make this the best in class by comparison with its peers - you can see the stats at https://destiny.report/w/747743636/redrixs-estoc and hopefully https://d2foundry.gg/w/747743636 will show how weapon stats impact in-game performance when the site is back up and running. The recoil is vertical but loose, so to tighten that up, look for a barrel perk that helps with Recoil Direction or, if you can handle it just go for extra handling, and then with the magazine perk go for something that helps improve magazine size or reload. For Stasis synergy and clearing groups of adds in general content, in the first trait perk column there's the choice of Rimestealer which generates ×1 stack (×2 stacks when enhanced) of Stasis Frost Armor on shattering a Stasis crystal or killing a frozen enemy, or Crystalline Corpsebloom which procs on a kill to provide a 4s buff - kills with the buff active generate a Stasis seeker which travels 3m before spawning a medium Stasis crystal (large when enhanced). In the second column, Headstone generates a Stasis crystal on a crit kill. The Stasis crystals are weapon-generated entities so can inherit damage buffs, and proc subclass fragments when shattered for AoE damage. You have a choice of stocks rather than origin traits - any can work so look for one that boosts your preferred weapon stat. If you're interested, Redrix-3 was an Exo Titan who was a legendary champion of the early Crucible, while an "estoc" is a 14th-century longsword designed to punch through chainmail or gaps in heavy plate armour. Recommended MW: Handling, with your preferred choice of mod to boost weapon stats, ammo generation, or elemental pickups for builds.

Inspired by @PodvsEnemies episode 133 from 11 March 2025 (https://open.spotify.com/episode/49VFDRj05iDXTJDOBqQpga?si=e61731a19fb64938) with @CourtProjects, @Saint_Kabr and @ImpetusAlways (PvE PvE-MinorSpec PvE-God M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE pick for use against Minor add groups in general at-level or better content, particularly with Stasis builds. Only the second-ever Legacy PR-55 frame pulse rifle, with the intrinsic offering "dramatically increased" hipfire performance. At base, the stats are top-tier by comparison with its peer - 54 Range and 20 Zoom equates to 34.09m ADS and 20.05m hipfire, 63 Stability is ×1.1967 flinch resist at 100 Resilience, 74 Handling is 0.31s ready, 0.31s ADS and 0.29s stow speed, 65 Reload Speed is a 1.65s reload and Recoil Direction is 65. The stats are pretty balanced, so you can boost Range, Stability, Handling and/or Reload Speed with the barrel and magazine perks, to your preference. For stasis builds, the trait perk combination of Rimestealer and Headstone generates Frost Armor stacks from freezing enemies and shattering the Stasis crystals for AoE damage from Headstone. There's no origin trait, but you have a choice of Stock perks instead - any of them work, depending on what you drop in the barrel and mag slots. If you're interested, an Estoc is a thrusting sword, from the Renaissance. Recommended MW: personal preference, as any will work, with a Backup Mag mod or, when fully enhanced, Synergy to create Stasis shards or, when the artifact mod's around, Stunloader. Also, don't forget to check whether there's a useful Seasonal Fragile mod for the activity you're running.

pandapaxxy (PvE / M+KB / Controller): "Redrix’s Estoc is not only a tongue twister but a decently strong pulse rifle. If you liked the BXR-55 Battler then this will feel right at home. If you wanted Stasis synergy, Rimestealer and Headstone are where it's at. If you don't, that's okay, the stats alone make up for it. Redrix's Estoc will be the Battler on steroids. Desperate Measures is great for having a rolling damage bonus. But the lack of a reload perk outside of Perpetual Motion is kind of weaksauce." Recommended MW: Reload Speed.

pandapaxxy (PvP / Controller): "Where Redrix's Estoc really gets to shine is of course in PvP. Lone Wolf, Zen Moment, and Rapid Hit all bump up the already high feel and stats for this weapon. And you can even delete a guardian in 5c1b with Sword Logic after a kill. Without stocks the pulse is already in a league of its own." Recommended MW: Range.
